# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest release on the default branch. Older releases may receive fixes at maintainer discretion.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.4.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.4   | :x:                |

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Please do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Report security issues through [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/NightBeamStudio/DonutShards/security/advisories/new) (private vulnerability reporting). Include:

- A description of the issue and potential impact
- Steps to reproduce or a proof of concept
- Affected versions
- Any suggested mitigation

We aim to acknowledge reports within a few business days and will coordinate disclosure and a fix before public release when possible.

## Safe disclosure

- Do not access data that is not yours, disrupt production services, or perform destructive testing on servers you do not own.
- Allow reasonable time for a fix before public disclosure.
